intent: The session-start hook keeps /.work/ out of git in every repository. Environment: a cloud session with several repositories starts in /home/user, which is not a git repository; the repositories are its children, and the hook input doesn't list them.

files.hooks/session-start.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || exit 0
echo '/.work/' >> "$root/.git/info/exclude"

test.risk: started in a non-git parent folder holding several repositories, the hook does nothing
test.body:
set -e
hook="$PWD/hooks/session-start.sh"; d=$(mktemp -d); git init -q "$d/a"; git init -q "$d/b"
(cd "$d" && bash "$hook")
for r in a b; do grep -qx '/.work/' "$d/$r/.git/info/exclude" || { echo "FAIL: $r: .work/ not excluded from a parent folder"; exit 1; }; done
test.output: FAIL: a: .work/ not excluded from a parent folder
